item.title: Measuring tire particles in stormwater runoff with a passive collector
item.content:encoded:
Nature Reviews Earth & Environment, Published online: 13 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s43017-026-00866-z

Zoé Arrigoni explains how a low-cost passive collector can be deployed within existing roadway spillways to quantify the mass fluxes of tire particles in stormwater runoff.
item.dc:title: Measuring tire particles in stormwater runoff with a passive collector
item.dc:creator: Zoé Arrigoni

item.title: Leveraging South America’s natural resources for sustainable development
item.content:encoded:
Nature Reviews Earth & Environment, Published online: 13 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s43017-026-00851-6

South America possesses globally important natural resources, yet its focus on extraction and exports has limited regional development. As demand for transition materials grows, the region should move beyond extractive development and instead use its natural wealth to strengthen domestic capabilities, foster economic resilience and prosperity, and protect critical ecosystems.
